mapper.select: select exec_id, cat_id, use_date, time_period, status, executor, exec_time, photos, photo_time, adverse_reaction, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from cat_medication_exec where cat_id = #{catId} and use_date = #{useDate} and ifnull(time_period, '') = ifnull(#{timePeriod}, '') limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cat_medication_exec ( cat_id, use_date, time_period, status, executor, exec_time, photos, photo_time, adverse_reaction, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{catId}, #{useDate}, #{timePeriod}, #{status}, #{executor}, #{execTime}, #{photos}, #{photoTime}, #{adverseReaction}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update cat_medication_exec
status = #{status}, executor = #{executor}, exec_time = #{execTime},
photos = #{photos}, photo_time = #{photoTime}, adverse_reaction = #{adverseReaction}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where exec_id = #{execId}
